correction.false_claim: hashed before any labelled table of the program existed
correction.statement: Labelled tables existed from 02:49, about 40 minutes before the rules were hashed. The proposer states that none of them was opened (inputs_read = BRIEF.md first paragraph and H1-H5; data/README.md; FZ.md sections 7-9 and 19). Blindness is therefore a process claim resting on the proposer's self-report and on the empty ledger (0 llm rows before registration), not a verifiable data-ordering fact. Deviation from the judges' 'user's words + dictionary' rule: FZ.md section 19 was also read; it prints ST7/ST8 priced nets, control percentiles and permutation p over the 2026 lab tape (= the OOS window) and no Foundation outcome by read or hour, so no rule cell is visibly informed by it. The same wording goes into studies/llm_hypotheses/FINDINGS.md and REPORT.md.
correction.unit_error: sess_range_atr is in ATR14 units and ATR14 on 1-minute bars is ~9 pts, so 'session range <= 2.5 ATR an hour in' (r0_m8) and '<= 3.0 ATR' (r0_f8) are far below the observed range; the rules are untestable on IS (see support_<tf>.json). The hashed rules are not re-thresholded; a corrected proposal would be a new round with its own sha and the multiplicity carried forward.

caveats: IS only; nothing was read from OOS beyond row counts (the OOS rows are in the same parquet; only `T.is_mask` rows were ever passed to a statistic).
Blindness of round 0 is the proposer's process claim (section 2); the labelled tables pre-date the hash by ~40 minutes; FZ.md 19 was read.
Three of sixteen rules are untestable on IS (no support): their ledger rows carry no diff, control percentile or permutation p; they count in every family statistic.
The pooled diff and the session-matched control can disagree in sign for a rule that keeps > 90% of the book (r0_f1); both are reported, neither alone is the criterion.

The 5-min studentised SPA p (0.045) is driven by r0_f1 with 33 active sessions of 408, just above the harness's exclusion floor of 20; it is not evidence of selection skill (that rule's pooled diff is -848 INR).
CPCV does not apply to fixed rules (no fitted threshold); go/no-go ran without the CPCV item; the per-block table is the stability statistic.
The max-T permutation shuffles net across IS rows (the harness's permutation convention), not by session block.
The L1 book is the futures tape cut at 15:25; option-type books are not in the cloud.
The proposer of round 0 has now seen the IS labels through this scoring; any later blind round needs a different agent (Judge 2).
falsifiers: a ledger row of one of these 16 unchanged rules with diff > 0, diff_top1_removed > 0, control pct >= 95 and Holm p (m=16) < 0.05 on a rebuilt L1 table
a different sign on another book (L0 agrees with L1 on 11 of 13 testable rules)
a max-T family-wise p < 0.05 under a session-block permutation
a registered round-1 proposal by a different agent surviving with the round-0 multiplicity carried forward (supersedes, does not overturn)
